item.title: Faster Retrieval for Better, More Efficient RAG
item.description: Maximum inner product search (MIPS) sits at the core of recommendation systems, search, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). Given a query vector, MIPS systems search within a database of millions of candidate key vectors for the one that best matches the query. The original data point associated with that best-matching key is then used to handle the query: in RAG, the document that is best suited to answer the question is typically prefixed to the query. As the number of keys grows to mill（Apple Machine Learning Research）

item.title: 美国中期选举蓝潮冲击 AI 行业，44 项数据中心暂停提案中 43 项通过 / ‘Total repudiation’: The blue wave is about to hit AI
item.description: 美国中期选举民主党拿下参众两院，多场竞选以问责 AI 公司为主题，行业面临监管、数据中心建设放缓等前景。44 项地方数据中心暂停提案中 43 项通过，NBC 民调显示 76% 选民反对在社区建数据中心；专家称共和党禁止州级 AI 限制的尝试可能终结，OpenAI 和 Anthropic 未置评，据华尔街日报报道 CEO 们在私下讨论算力容量受限问题。（The Verge：AI（RSS））
